reconstruction_notes: Use the exact slide canvas size in ReportLab points (EMU / 12700) so all geometry maps without scaling.
Use original PNG media as Image XObjects at their listed placements; do not first downsample through PowerPoint.
Build all texts and basic vector shapes in PDF with their native coordinates. Keep original z order from slide XML.

For outer shadows and glow, precompose only the effect layer at 600 dpi from its alpha mask, then place it behind untouched original PNG/text; this avoids dark-color effect clipping and retains high-detail source artwork.
Write link annotations for every hyperlink_uses entry with the exact transformed geometry and the external target in relationships.
Embedded .fntdata parts are not directly usable TTF files. Resolve typefaces from theme/run properties against installed system fonts or use a defined fallback while preserving point size/weight.
Nested group coordinate transforms must be composed from grpSp xfrm child coordinate spaces before drawing children.
